list.title: Owner's Project Management
list.summary: Representing the owner's interests through pre-construction, design, bidding, and construction, protecting budget, schedule, and quality from concept to close-out.

list.title: Clerk of the Works
list.summary: On-site construction oversight that verifies work matches the drawings, specifications, and schedule, documenting progress and issues on the owner's behalf.

list.title: Construction Advisory
list.summary: Independent construction guidance for owners: reviewing contracts, budgets, bids, and schedules so decisions are made with clear information.
